participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: Every scheme signed off here has looked affordable on the day and heavy on the accounts three years later. Sitting with the finance papers, I keep asking what this place will cost the city to keep once the ribbon is cut.

participants.name: Kenji

persona.name: Kenji
persona.personality: Kenji is curious and actively takes on challenges. He values his friends and enjoys communicating with those around him. Although he can be a little clumsy at times, he is always positive and never abandons those in need. He is easygoing and well-liked by those around him.

participants.private_seed: Delivery dates in this city have a way of drifting once the diggers arrive, and the ground here has surprised us before. Before anyone commits, I want to know what this site and the handful of firms willing to work here will really let us finish.

participants.name: Minako

persona.name: Minako
persona.personality: Minako is very calm and acts calmly in any situation. Even when those around her are emotional, she grasps the facts firmly and responds calmly. As a result, she is often asked for her opinion and often takes on a leadership role. She rarely shows her emotions, but she also has a kind side that she shows to those she trusts. She can be a little stubborn and is strong in her convictions. She is also confident in her physical strength and never neglects her training.

participants.private_seed: Something in how this city commissions work keeps producing handsome openings and short lives. I would rather judge by what the last decade of our schemes looks like now than by drawings.

participants.name: Benjamin

persona.name: Benjamin
persona.personality: Benjamin is an intelligent and calm person. He is able to think calmly and rationally, and even in emotional situations, he places importance on logic. In public, he is elegant and polite, often incorporating sarcasm and humor into his conversations, but he is skilled at doing so without hurting others, creating a harmonious atmosphere. He also has an introverted side, often engrossed in deep thought, and occasionally keeps his distance from those around him. However, his calmness and knowledge are factors that earn him the trust of others even in difficult situations.

participants.private_seed: This park is not an empty stage; it is crossed, drained, mown and rained on every week of the year. What worries me is that we pick something which reads well on paper and then fights the way the ground and the people here actually behave.

participants.name: Minato

persona.name: Minato
persona.personality: Minato has a calm personality and likes to interact with people around him in a peaceful manner. He is a little naive and sometimes has an expression that makes it difficult to understand what he is thinking, but his innocence makes him a soothing presence to those around him. He is very curious and shows interest in everything, especially learning new things. He is highly sensitive and sensitive to the feelings of others, but he is not good at asserting himself and sometimes has difficulty expressing his opinions.

participants.private_seed: Every new thing the city opens lands on the same rota, and that rota is shorter each year. I am trying to work out who would really run and look after this place, week in and week out.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a redevelopment plan for a central municipal park. A five-person review panel appointed by a city government examines the redevelopment plans prepared for a central park. One plan will be recommended to the council. Participants: Jonathan, Kenji, Minako, Benjamin and Minato. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Terms of the regional habitat fund
- Upkeep ledger spend per hectare
- Regional firms tendering for earth-moving
- Depot phasing notes on hoarding the site
- Record of the eastern avenue planting
- Condition of works from the earlier programme
- Timed counts of weekday crossings
- Drainage callouts and August heat readings
- Groundskeeping roll and bought-in services
- Volunteer groups working with the division

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Kenji, Benjamin, Minato, Minako and Jonathan. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the candidates | 4 turns | every participant votes; the candidate with the most votes is selected |
